en.headline: Kennedy Town New Praya seawall proposed as Grade 2 historic structure
en.dek: The Antiquities Advisory Board endorsed the grading for the 19th-century granite wall as the government plans a new waterfront boardwalk.
body: The Antiquities Advisory Board has endorsed a proposal to list the New Praya seawall in Kennedy Town as a Grade 2 historic structure. Officials said the granite face dates from the nineteenth century and is among the older remaining seawalls on the northern shore of Hong Kong Island. Grade 2 denotes buildings or structures of special merit for which selective preservation should be sought.

A curator at the Antiquities and Monuments Office said the wall has stood for more than 130 years and marks an early reclamation that helped Kennedy Town develop, though it is not the district’s first-generation 1870s seawall. Later reclamations removed stretches at both ends, shortening what was once about 1,400 feet to about 620 feet.

Harbourfront Commission chairman Ivan Ho Man-yiu said on a radio programme on Friday that a planned 200-metre, 10-metre-wide pedestrian boardwalk along the praya had already been designed to stand off the wall so people could view it from different distances. The project involves about 0.25 hectares of reclamation, with works expected to start in mid-2028 and finish in mid-2031. Ho said the commission was looking at how the walkway might use technology to show the waterfront’s earlier life as a working dock.

zh.headline: 堅彌地城新海旁海堤擬列二級歷史建築
zh.dek: 古諮會通過擬議評級，海濱事務委員會主席何文堯稱新板道會離開海堤，方便從不同距離觀看。
body: 古物諮詢委員會通過將堅彌地城新海旁海堤擬議評為二級歷史建築。當局指整段立面由花崗石塊砸成，建於19世紀，屬港島北岸較早期仍存的海堤之一。二級評級指具特別價值、應予選擇性保存的建築物或構築物。
古跡辦歷史建築館長表示，海堤屹立逾130年，見證早期填海及堅尼地城發展，但並非1870年代第一代填海所建的海堤。其後大規模填海令東西兩端海堤消失，原長約1,400呎的海堤現縮至約620呎。
海濱事務委員會主席何文堯周五在電台節目表示，政府計劃沿海旁興建長200米、闊10米的行人板道時，設計已離開海堤，讓市民可從不同角度及距離觀看，建造期間亦須確保不影響海堤穩定性。工程涉及填海約0.25公頃，料2028年中動工、2031年中完成。何文堯說，委員會正研究結合科技，展示這段海濱昔日作為工作碼頭的情況。
